data_rights: Scryfall API card text and scans; Wizards of the Coast card content, used for noncommercial fan OCR research. Not relicensed as crate source.
normalization: English Latin; curly quotes/dashes and accented letters normalized to pretrained alphabet. Mana glyphs excluded from synthetic labels.
split_policy: sha256(casefold(card name)) modulo10:0=test,1=validation,2..9=train. All printings/fonts/crops/augmentations grouped.
